authority: CP-01 owner-approved D-04; G4-07 exact source ceilings; CT-05-P1,P2,N1
provenance: Only actual _capture_child applied seconds and stream byte caps may create capture-limit dimension witness. No inference from `capture_limited` boolean, no invented missing extent.

cases.given: src command real _capture_child timed_out after applied seconds cap
cases.expected: CaptureLimit threshold applied seconds, unit seconds, observed factual elapsed_seconds, missing_extent null, affected exact call scope

cases.given: source artifact limited by known byte cap and known lower-bound omitted bytes
cases.expected: CaptureLimit unit bytes; threshold actual approved effective stream limit; observed actual retained bytes; missing_extent only known lower bound

cases.given: source timed out, existing metadata capture_limited True
cases.expected: Never publish byte threshold for a timed-out source; reject missing/wrong effective-cap witness

cases.given: no captured or truncated evidence or runtime cap event
cases.expected: No CaptureLimit record; cannot assume missing bytes

cases.given: historical receipt without required applied-time-cap evidence
cases.expected: Do not fabricate effective ceiling; retain original and mark provisional or fail closed

scope: No change to G4-07 source authorization, executed argv or canonical/status version; private operational witness versioned for active limit events; synthetic mock-only tests do not close independent acceptance.
